claims: C1 the developer message instructs the assistant to always respond via function calls, never with plaintext
C2 for an ambiguous question the assistant should use the ask_clarifying_question tool
C3 the good response is a function call to ask_clarifying_question; the bad response is a plaintext message

concepts.name: interactive_vs_programmatic_setting
concepts.gloss: whether the assistant is interacting with a human in real time (interactive) or its output will be consumed programmatically; behavior varies accordingly

concepts.name: guideline_authority
concepts.gloss: rules in sections marked authority=guideline carry guideline-level instruction authority

concepts.name: developer_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given by the developer message in this example

concepts.name: ambiguous_question
concepts.gloss: Q is a user question that is ambiguous, so the developer message directs the assistant to ask for clarification

concepts.name: plaintext_response
concepts.gloss: R is a standard plaintext message to the user, as opposed to a function call

concepts.name: function_call_response
concepts.gloss: R is a response delivered as a function call, such as a call to ask_clarifying_question

concepts.name: ask_clarifying_question_tool
concepts.gloss: the ask_clarifying_question tool defined in the developer message's function namespace

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.gloss: response R answers user question Q
concepts.inference: the example pairs each response with the user question it answers, so a relation between a response and a question is needed

ontology.gloss: the developer message instructs the assistant to always respond via function calls
the developer message instructs the assistant never to respond with plaintext
the developer message instructs the assistant to use ask_clarifying_question for ambiguous questions

asserts.read_back: responding with % is forbidden because the developer message requires function calls and forbids plaintext responses
responding with % is preferred: a function call is the good response in this example
using % is preferred for an ambiguous question, as the developer message directs
asserts.body: T = ask_clarifying_question_tool, ambiguous_question(Q), answers_question(R, Q), function_call_response(R)

closure.reason: the example forbids plaintext responses and prefers function calls; it does not forbid other response forms, so silence leaves them permitted
the example directs use of ask_clarifying_question for ambiguous questions but does not forbid other tools, so silence leaves them permitted
